claims.text: In 2018 Kīlauea's summit collapsed as the magma beneath it drained to the lower East Rift Zone
claims.source: PDF title (text.txt:2-3) + https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/kilauea/2018-lower-east-rift-zone-eruption-and-summit-collapse ('partially drained the summit magma reservoir')
claims.evidence: PDF title + USGS 2018 eruption page: LERZ eruption "partially drained the summit magma reservoir" (causal link sourced to that page, not the PDF alone).

claims.text: Kīlauea is on the Island of Hawaiʻi; marker at 19.421 N, 155.287 W
claims.source: text.txt:87 ('event on the Island of Hawaiʻi'); coordinates https://www.usgs.gov/volcanoes/kilauea Quick Facts
claims.evidence: PDF p.2 box: "event on the Island of Hawaiʻi"; USGS Kīlauea Quick Facts 19.421 N, 155.287 W (marker placed there).

claims.text: The source is a two-page USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory summary, September 2018
claims.source: PDF (2 pages); text.txt page-1 footer 'USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory, September 2018'
claims.evidence: PDF is 2 pages; footer "USGS Hawaiian Volcano Observatory, September 2018".

claims.text: April 30: the Puʻu ʻŌʻō vent collapses
claims.evidence: Chronology Apr 30 verbatim. Narration "the Puʻu ʻŌʻō vent collapsed" matches.

claims.text: May 3: fissure eruptions begin on the lower East Rift Zone
claims.evidence: Chronology May 3 "Onset of LERZ fissure eruptions" (not May 2 ground cracks). On screen "Fissure eruptions begin".

claims.text: May 4: magnitude-6.9 earthquake on Kīlauea's south flank
claims.evidence: Chronology May 4 "Magnitude-6.9 earthquake on south flank". Narration drops "south flank" (shorter, still true).

claims.text: Mid-May: shaking and ground tilt forced HVO staff out of their building on the caldera rim (chronology: May 16, HVO building vacated)
claims.evidence: Chronology May 16 "HVO building vacated" + caption: vacated due to damage from earthquake shaking and ground tilting. Narration "By mid-May, shaking and ground tilt had forced ... out of its building" matches.

claims.text: From May 29, near-daily summit collapse events, each releasing energy equivalent to a ~M5 earthquake
claims.evidence: Chronology May 29 near-daily collapse events, each "releasing energy equivalent to that of a ~M5 earthquake". Narration "each with the energy of a magnitude 5 earthquake" and screen "≈ M5 energy" are energy equivalences, not claims that they were M5 quakes (B6 respected).

claims.text: Maximum subsidence more than 500 m (1,600 ft); profiles April 2018 vs August 2018
claims.evidence: Cross-section caption: maximum subsidence more than 500 m (1,600 ft). Figure redrawn by hand from PDF p.2 points, labelled "redrawn from USGS figure"; skyscraper silhouette left out (B7).

claims.text: Fissure 8 fountained to heights of 200 feet at times (May 29 footage)
claims.source: https://www.usgs.gov/media/videos/kilauea-volcano-fissure-8-overflight (page text; also the clip's own end card)
claims.evidence: USGS media page for the May 29 clip: fissure 8 "fountaining to heights of 200 feet at times" (also on the clip end card). Narration "fountains rose 200 feet at times".

claims.text: June 3: lava from fissure 8 reaches the ocean at Kapoho Bay
claims.evidence: Chronology June 3 verbatim; page 1 photo caption repeats it. June 11 footage is labelled with its own date, the June 3 fact is a separate card.

claims.text: 13.7 square miles of land inundated by lava (35.5 km² on the PDF's map legend)
claims.evidence: Stats bullet 13.7 square miles; 35.5 km² from the PDF page-1 map legend.

claims.text: 716 dwellings destroyed by lava (per Hawaiʻi County)
claims.evidence: Stats bullet "716 dwellings destroyed by lava (per Hawaiʻi County)". Screen keeps the County attribution; narration "Hawaiʻi County counted 716 homes destroyed" (B4 respected).

claims.text: 875 acres of new land created by ocean entries

claims.evidence: Stats bullet "~60,000 earthquakes April 30–August 4, 2018"; screen "~60,000", narration "about 60,000".
Title "Preliminary summary"; screen "Preliminary figures, USGS, Sept 2018".

claims.text: Aug 4: fissure 8 activity significantly decreases; summit deflation stops
claims.evidence: Chronology Aug 4 "LERZ fissure 8 activity significantly decreases; summit deflation stops". Narration "In early August, the eruption faded" (paraphrase allowed by the facts file).
